title: 第一卷 第94章 筑基筑基胆大包天第一卷 第93章 再炼筑基丹成
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: “林客卿，我就说你的运势不错！真是精品筑基丹！”
宋丹师将两枚废丹收起，拿出那枚成丹笑道。
“多谢宋丹师！”林寻上前接过，拱手行礼道。
“这是你的机缘，祝你早日筑基，仙道长青！
莫要被那日之事影响了心性。”
“宋前辈说的是，在下省的。”
对于此种阻碍，若林寻二三十岁时可能会耿耿于怀。
可现在，他已经一百二十岁，早已看透修仙界的本质。
自身实力强大，才是硬道理。
说了几句场面话后，林寻悄然离开万宝楼。
回到水月居院落后，他脸上显出一丝阴郁。
“早些时日就去租借过二阶洞府，可得到的答复是没有空缺。
金阳山下的那种洞府，不是一般人能承受，却一直没有空缺。
何解？
傻子都知道被针对了。
就算这不是姬映雪一系的本意，也必定脱不了干系。
好！
好的很啊！”
不论如何，这笔帐都要算在他们头上。
可现在，他还是需要想办法筑基。
既然在此地被针对，就不能改头换面再去金阳山。
毕竟是有真丹真人存在的地方。
危险性极大！
“那就只能另寻他法。”
林寻打开从万宝楼得来的地图。
“能供应筑基的灵脉，需要二阶以上，金阳城方圆千里内，只有几处地方可选。
秦家有两名筑基，坐拥二阶下品灵脉。
青枫谷有筑基后期大修，坐拥二阶上品灵脉。
他的指尖一路下滑，最终点在了一处湖泊。
“半月湖慕家，族内四名筑基，坐拥二阶中品灵脉！
上次遇到后，我就关注过此家的情况。
有消息称，其家族内的筑基初期家主频频外出，压的周围势力苦不堪言。
可越是如此，越显得心虚！”
林寻沉声道。
他曾确认过，那日二阶区域的筑基修士，确实是慕家之人。
以当时听到的惨叫。
表明三位筑基大概率都没了。
竟想偷天月狼的幼崽，当真是嫌命长。
比较下来，这里确实是最好的地方。
就算几位筑基还在，也定然大伤，没有数十年苦修恢复不了。
他只要小心一点，布置好阵法，再加上足量的灵乳供应，定能迅速突破筑基，并成功而返。
当然，这是最坏的打算。
content_en:
"Lin Keqing, let me tell you that your luck is good! It's really a fine foundation-building pill!"
Master Song put away the two useless pills, took out the completed pill and smiled.
"Thank you, Alchemist Song!" Lin Xun stepped forward to take it, cupping his hands and saluting.
"This is your opportunity, I wish you will build your foundation soon and your immortal path will last forever!
Don't let the events of that day affect your character. "
"Senior Song said he was in Xia Province."
Ruo Linxun might feel resentful about this kind of obstacle when he was in his twenties and thirties.
But now, he is one hundred and twenty years old and has already seen through the essence of the world of immortality.
Being strong yourself is the last word.
...
After saying a few words, Lin Xun quietly left Wanbao Tower.
After returning to Shuiyue Juyuan, there was a hint of gloom on his face.
“I went to rent a second-level cave a while ago, but the answer I received was that there was no vacancy.
The kind of cave at the foot of Jinyang Mountain is not something ordinary people can afford, but there has never been a vacancy.
What’s the explanation?
All fools know they are being targeted.
Even if this is not the original intention of Ji Yingxue and his family, it is definitely related.
OK!
Very good! "
No matter what, the account will be borne by them.
But now, he still needs to find a way to build a foundation.
Since we are being targeted here, we cannot change our appearance and go to Jinyang Mountain again.
After all, this is a place where the true elixir exists.
Extremely dangerous!
"Then we have to find another way."
Lin Xun opened the map he got from Wanbao Tower.
“The spiritual veins that can supply foundation building require level two or above, and there are only a few places to choose from within a thousand miles of Jinyang City.
The Qin family has two foundation builders with second-level low-grade spiritual veins.
Qingfeng Valley has undergone major repairs in the later stages of foundation building, and has second-level high-grade spiritual veins.
......."
His fingertips slid down and finally touched a lake.
"The Banyuehu Mu family, four members of the family have established foundations and have second-level mid-level spiritual veins!
I have been paying attention to the situation of this home since the last encounter.
It is reported that the head of the family in the early stage of foundation building frequently went out, which suppressed the surrounding forces and made them miserable.
But the more this happens, the more guilty he appears! "
Lin Xun said in a deep voice.
He had confirmed that the foundation-building monks in the second-level area that day were indeed members of the Mu family.
With the screams I heard at that time.
It shows that there is a high probability that the three foundation builders are gone.
He actually wanted to steal the Sky Moon Wolf's cub, he really thought he had a long life.
In comparison, this is indeed the best place.
Even if a few foundation builders are still there, they will definitely be seriously injured and will not be able to recover even after decades of hard work.
As long as he is careful, arranges the formation well, and has a sufficient supply of spiritual milk, he will be able to break through the foundation quickly and return successfully.
Of course, this is the worst case scenario.
